description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/service-for-your-fridge">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceRequest" name="Fridge symptoms and type"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceAssignment" name="Service assignment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Appointment" name="Appointment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairComplete" name="Repair complete"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Confirmation that the fridge is OK"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rating" name="Service facility rating"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FridgesNoises" name="Fridge produces strange noises"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms and fridge type"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendServiceRequest" name="Send service request" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAppointment" name="Receive appointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AppointmentReceived" name="Appointment received"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RepairComplete" name="Repair complete">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RepairComplete" messageRef="Message_RepairComplete"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" name="Confirm fridge is OK" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateService" name="Rate the service facility?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRating" name="Send service facility rating" messageRef="Message_Rating"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerFollowUp" name="Confirmation and optional rating completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_FridgesNoises" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="Task_SendServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment" targetRef="End_AppointmentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Start_RepairComplete" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" targetRef="Gateway_RateService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Rating" name="Rate the facility" sourceRef="Gateway_RateService" targetRef="Task_SendRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${rateServiceFacility}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_SkipRating" name="Do not rate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateService" targetRef="End_CustomerFollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SendRating" targetRef="End_CustomerFollowUp"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CentralServiceCenter" name="Central fridge service center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AssignFacility" name="Send service assignment" messageRef="Message_ServiceAssignment"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FacilityAssigned" name="Local service facility selected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="Task_AssignFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignFacility" targetRef="End_FacilityAssigned"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LocalServiceFacility" name="Local service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceAssignment" name="Service assignment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceAssignment" messageRef="Message_ServiceAssignment"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make an appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Arrive" name="Arrive at a random time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsNeeded" name="Are additional parts needed?" default="Flow_NoParts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing the fridge"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairNotCompleted" name="Repair not completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair the fridge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyRepairComplete" name="Notify customer that repair is complete" messageRef="Message_RepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive confirmation that the fridge is OK" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairConfirmed" name="Repair confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceAssignment" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Task_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_Arrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Task_Arrive" targetRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsNeeded" name="Additional parts are needed" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalPartsNeeded}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Leave" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="End_RepairNotCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoParts" name="No additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="Task_NotifyRepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepairComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_RepairConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ServiceForFridge">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CentralServiceCenter" name="Central fridge service center" processRef="Process_CentralServiceCenter"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LocalServiceFacility" name="Local service facility" processRef="Process_LocalServiceFacility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRequest" name="Fridge symptoms and type" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Start_ServiceRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceAssignment" name="Service assignment" sourceRef="Task_AssignFacility" targetRef="Start_ServiceAssignment" messageRef="Message_ServiceAssignment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Appointment" name="Appointment" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairComplete" name="Repair complete" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepairComplete" targetRef="Start_RepairComplete" messageRef="Message_RepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Confirmation that the fridge is OK" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rating" name="Service facility rating" sourceRef="Task_SendRating" targetRef="Participant_LocalServiceFacility" messageRef="Message_Rating"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
